name: @zyno-io/zynohosting
stderr:
Usage: zynohosting [options] [command]

Manage and deploy ZynoHosting sites

Options:
  -V, --version                                    output the version number
  --api-url <url>                                  Hosting Manager API URL
  --suite-api-url <url>                            ZynoSuite API URL
  --auth-api-url <url>                             ZynoAuth API URL
  --environment <name>                             Hosting environment (choices: "production", "alpha", "dev")
  --api-key <key>                                  tenant API key (prefer ZYNOHOSTING_API_KEY)
  --json                                           emit machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help                                       display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                                  sign in through ZynoSuite or save a CI API key
  logout [options]                                 revoke the saved scoped token and remove local credentials
  sites                                            list and inspect authorized sites
  files                                            list, download, upload, and delete individual files
  deploy|deploy-site [options] <site> [directory]  preview and synchronize a local directory to a hosted site
  download [options] <site> [directory]            download a complete hosted-site snapshot
  mcp [options]                                    run the local ZynoHosting and ZynoForms MCP server
  help [command]                                   display help for command
